backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor that combines authorization and blob-storage mixins, manages user profiles with role-based access control, and handles event registrations (workshop/competition/seminar) with admin-only retrieval of all submissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with their IDs, titles, affected files, component dependencies, and test IDs — covering the phoenix video/audio intro, text animation sync, and other UI changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document providing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the purpose and key behavior of each component and page.
frontend/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'ELECTROSPARKS' with a root div and a module script tag pointing to the React entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that shows the PhoenixIntro once per session (via sessionStorage), then renders the full TanStack Router app with eight routes wrapped in RegistrationProvider and QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/CircuitPattern.t: Decorative SVG component that renders a tiled orange/red circuit-board pattern as an absolutely-positioned, pointer-events-none overlay with configurable opacity.
frontend/src/components/CountdownTimer.t: Live countdown timer component that counts down to March 10, 2026 and updates every second, displaying days/hours/minutes/seconds with orange neon glow styling in Times New Roman.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a site footer with brand info, quick navigation links, and contact details styled with a black/orange theme using inline styles and Lucide icons.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Displays an animated loading screen with a canvas-drawn waveform, progress bar, and cycling status messages that calls onComplete after ~3 seconds.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky responsive navigation bar with desktop links and a mobile hamburger menu, highlighting the active route and applying scroll-based styling changes.
frontend/src/components/PhoenixIntro.tsx: Full-screen intro animation component that plays a video with synchronized audio, canvas particle/ember effects, and sequenced text fade-ins before calling onComplete.
frontend/src/contexts/RegistrationContex: Provides a React context for storing, updating, and clearing event registration form data across the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a `useSubmitRegistration` React Query mutation hook that calls the backend actor's `submitRegistration` method and invalidates the 'registrations' query cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for a dark neon-cyan theme, and provides utility classes for neon text, borders, and glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying staff and student coordinator details (names, roles, phone numbers) in glassmorphism cards with an orange neon aesthetic and circuit background.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing/hero page for the VibECX-2K26 symposium showing event stats (prize pool, colleges, participants, events) with animated fade-in, gradient title, and navigation buttons.
frontend/src/pages/NonTechnicalEvents.ts: Page listing five non-technical events (AD-MAD, JAM, Dump Charades, Talent Show, E-Sports) in a responsive grid with icon cards and hover effects.
frontend/src/pages/Payment.tsx: Payment page that displays a QR code amount loaded from localStorage, accepts a screenshot upload via drag-and-drop or file input, and submits the full registration to the backend actor on confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/Register.tsx: Registration form page for VibECX-2K26 that collects participant details, calculates fees based on member count and event type, validates inputs, and navigates to the payment page.
frontend/src/pages/Schedule.tsx: Event schedule page displaying a filterable list of timed sessions (technical, non-technical, general) with venue and description details for the symposium day.
frontend/src/pages/Success.tsx: Post-registration success page that confirms submission, informs the user that a confirmation email will be sent, and provides a link back to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/TechnicalEvents.tsx: Static page listing the five technical events for VibECX-2K26 (Paper Presentation, PCB Design, Technical Crosscode, Tech Talk, Quiz Master) with icons and descriptions in a responsive grid.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing helper functions to read, persist, and clear URL query parameters from both standard query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the theme with custom neon cyan colors, neon box-shadow utilities, custom font families (Orbitron, Share Tech Mono, Rajdhani), oklch-based semantic color tokens, and animation keyframes for accordion and neon effects.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the VibECX-2K26 event app project, including schema version, architectural notes, known issues, and a detailed list of existing implemented features covering the phoenix intro animation, audio sync, QR payment flow, and home page navigation.
